Former Fulham coach Javier Pereira has urged Barcelona to sign Nigerian defender Calvin Bassey, insisting that he has the physical profile that coach Hansi Flick lacks in big matches. Pereira made the appeal in an interview with Marca on November 18. He said his former player would immediately improve the Catalans, who are looking for a centre-back in the January transfer window. Barcelona have not been linked with the Fulham man. Pereira said Barcelona have no centre-back like Bassey, who has “a different physical and athletic profile, something Flick is lacking in important matches”. He praised the 26-year-old’s ability to play on a high defensive line, his aggression in the opposition half and his speed. Pereira also highlighted his ability to carry the ball past midfielders, saying that apart from Pau Cubarsi, Barcelona have no one with “the ability to break lines with his dribbling”. Pereira argued that a move to Spain would suit Bassey better than a switch to Manchester United, citing his tactical maturity and positive body language. Fulham are reportedly open to a sale and have placed a €55m price tag on him. Bassey has played every minute of Fulham’s 10 league games this season under Álvaro Arbeloa.
